latest.headline: MU set to gap down about 6% as Asia memory sinks
latest.tldr: MU closed Tuesday at $629.79 (−11.01%) after a BNP Paribas downgrade, last printed $589.43 (−6.4%) at 7:18 ET, and I expect an open about 4% to 9% lower (roughly $573–$605), with the 8:30 ET inflation data able to push it to either end.
